title: Grettel
creator: CrossFit
description: Ten rounds of 3 clean and jerks at 135/95 lb and 3 burpees over the bar. A 2021 Girl that is essentially Grace with burpees between every three reps, so the barbell never gets to feel fresh. Scale the load so every set can be touch-and-go.
